# Security policy

## Supported versions

Only the **latest version** of Bitty Buddies gets security fixes. The app updates itself, so most people are always on it. You can check yours in the tray menu.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please **don't** open a public issue or post about it on Discord.

Report it privately instead: go to this repo's **Security** tab and click **Report a vulnerability**. Only the Bitty Buddies team can see it.

Useful things to include:

- what the problem is and what someone could do with it
- the steps to make it happen
- your app version and Windows version

We'll reply within a few days, keep you updated while we fix it, and credit you in the release notes if you'd like.

## What counts

Problems in the Bitty Buddies app, its licence keys, accounts, the website or the Bitty Buddies server. Things like spam, abuse or a lost key aren't security problems: ask on our [Discord](https://discord.gg/aCHyjABJG7) instead.
